assumptions.text: Single-node baseline ceiling assumed; description omits device counts, rates and volumes.

entries.driver: Bursty 1Hz samples per device, many devices; packet size bounded per PA-01.
In-process event fan-in, one event per accepted sample; bounded per PA-01.
Few long-lived downstream subscribers, demand-driven window fan-out per PA-01.

budgets.limit: Fixed byte ceiling per packet per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Packet over ceiling rejected with payload-too-large status; none persisted

budgets.limit: Fixed sample count per packet per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Packet over sample cap rejected whole; zero appends observed

budgets.limit: Fixed packets admitted per window per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Excess packets answered with too-many-requests status

budgets.limit: Fixed concurrent appends, bound from config

measurement.assertion: Concurrency limit read from bounded config key; observed in-flight never exceeds it

budgets.limit: Fixed maximum connections, bound from config

measurement.assertion: Pool maximum read from bounded config key

budgets.limit: Every store call carries a configured timeout budget

measurement.assertion: Timeout read from bounded config key; stalled call errors

budgets.limit: At most two queries per packet regardless of sample count

measurement.assertion: Query counter per packet at most two for maximum sample count

budgets.limit: Fixed sample capacity, bound from config

measurement.assertion: Depth never exceeds capacity; overflow answered by rejection status

budgets.limit: Fixed event capacity, bound from config

measurement.assertion: Depth never exceeds capacity under slow consumer

budgets.limit: Overflow dropped and counted, ingestion never blocked

measurement.assertion: Dropped counter equals events beyond capacity

budgets.target: Window buffer per device and metric
budgets.limit: Fixed window sample capacity, bound from config

measurement.assertion: Window depth never exceeds capacity after sustained inserts
Subscriber beyond limit answered with service-unavailable status

budgets.limit: Fixed page size ceiling per read

measurement.assertion: Range read returns at most page-size rows

budgets.limit: Fixed attempt count, then drop with counter

measurement.assertion: Emit attempts never exceed configured maximum

invariants.rule: No unbounded queue or buffer on the event stream path.
No unbounded reorder buffer; overflow rejected, never silent.
Saturation answered with rejection status, never absorbed.
Every retry bounded; one bounded policy per path.

duties.obligation: Reject oversize packets before parsing or persisting.
Reject packets over sample cap atomically.
Admit packets within rate; reject excess with status.
Hold one bounded in-flight append limit.
Cap store connections at configured maximum.
Apply timeout budget to every store call.
Load and append per packet in constant query count.
Bound reorder window buffer; reject on overflow.
Bound event stream buffer with configured capacity.
Drop overflow events and increment drop counter.
Evict oldest window samples beyond capacity.
Cap concurrent subscribers; reject excess with status.
Cap rows returned per range read.
Bound emit retries; drop with counter after limit.

risks.risk: No real rates or volumes declared; budget numbers are baseline guesses.
risks.mitigation: accepted: numbers set from PA-01, tunable through config
risks.residual: Budgets may under- or over-admit until real load is known.

risks.risk: Dropped events on overflow lose live distribution samples.
risks.residual: Live window gaps possible; stored history stays complete and replayable.

risks.risk: Wall-clock latency targets cannot be proven by deterministic gates.
risks.mitigation: operator: latency verified by post-delivery load run
risks.residual: Latency unproven at stage-1; only counts, sizes and statuses gated.
